Yes. **DonorDock includes built-in online giving**, with unlimited, customizable online giving pages and embeddable donation forms.

Key points from DonorDock’s own materials:

- DonorDock offers **Online Giving pages** that connect to Stripe and PayPal to process donations, and each gift is automatically recorded in your DonorDock account in real time.[1]  
- You can **create unlimited giving pages** for campaigns, events, memberships, recurring giving, etc., and use them as standalone pages or embed the forms directly into your website.[1][2][6]  
- DonorDock’s pricing explicitly includes **“FREE Online Giving pages”** as part of the platform.[7]  
- Donors can give via major cards, ACH, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and other methods depending on your payment processor setup.[1][6]  

So if you are asking whether DonorDock can handle **online donations directly** (not just CRM tracking), the answer is yes—it has a full online giving feature set built in.
